148633.overview: Inspired by the arcade game Pac-Man, and based on the game Micro Maze, Dot Man is a single screen maze game where you must move around a maze and eat all the dots. As you eat the dots, two creatures move around the maze attempting to catch you and if they do then it is game over. There is also an option to play a faster game.

148652.overview: Duck shoot is a gallery shooter for the Jupiter Ace computer. It was developed and published by MICRO Marketing in 1983.
